TS003 too-many-parameters

A function takes at most `parameters_max` parameters; past that the arguments are easy to mix up and belong in an options struct.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Good function shape is often the inverse of an hourglass: a few parameters, a simple return type, and a lot of meaty logic between the braces."
